subject: [Math-ters] Change of Venues for Lessons
snippet: Dear students, First of all, I apologize for the multiple invitations sent to you via Google Calendar. Kindly ignore all the invitations. To avoid any confusion, I have attached a copy of my timetable
body_text:
Dear students,

First of all, I apologize for the multiple invitations sent to you via
Google Calendar. Kindly ignore all the invitations.

To avoid any confusion, I have attached a copy of my timetable to with the
venues stated. Please refer to it and note down in your own timetable. This
will be applicable for Term 1 only, starting next week.

Please be punctual and I will allow a  5-minute allowance to reach the
venue(s).

Thank you.

*Peh Pei Hsin Desmond 白培新*
Academic Staff, Mathematics Department
Teacher In-Charge, Fencing






*School of Science and Technology, Singapore1 Technology Drive Singapore
138572Tel: (65) [phone_719f412e] (ext. 228) | Fax: (65) [phone_55758dd3]**
